name: Bacon Cheeseburger Egg Bake
why: Egg-and-cream custard poured over browned beef and bacon, topped with cheddar and baked - a cheese-bound casserole whose structure is the egg/cheese bake (in-lane 'cheese-bound casserole'). Published 503 cal / 42g protein / 5g carbs sits dead-center of the 400-650 band and blows past the 25g+ protein identity, with carbs far under 35. No bread/potato/rice/bean base. Every ingredient maps to the board (ground-beef-8020, eggs, heavy-cream, bacon, shredded-cheese, cream-cheese, ketchup, mustard, worcestershire, onions, garlic) - zero unmapped, high confidence. BEEF, which diversifies an egg-bake pool that is otherwise all pork (three pork quiches/bakes already staged). Weigh-and-divide 9x13 bake, scales cleanly to 14 servings. Not a dup: catalog only has cheeseburger-pasta and cheeseburger-rice-bowls (both carb bases), no egg-bound bake.
